name: Wall Passing
instructions: Stand 5 feet from a wall. Pass the ball to a target on the wall and reset the platform before each rep.

name: Platform Passing
instructions: A partner tosses to the left and the right. Pass each ball to a target at the net with a still platform.

name: Serve Receive Under Pressure
instructions: Take live serves in a rotation. Call the ball, pass to the setter target, and stay low for the next ball.

name: Jump Serve
instructions: Toss in front of the hitting shoulder, jump, and contact the ball at the peak toward a deep zone.

name: Float Serve Target
instructions: Serve a float from the end line to zones 1, 5, and 6. Count only serves that land in the called zone.

name: Standing Serve
instructions: Serve from behind the end line with a still toss and a firm contact. Aim for the back third of the court.

name: Setter Footwork
instructions: Start in a ready stance. Move to a tossed ball, square the hips to the target, and set a high ball to the outside.

name: Target Setting
instructions: Set from the net to a basket at the left antenna. Release the ball from the forehead and follow through to the target.

name: Out-of-System Setting
instructions: Take passes off the net and past the 10-foot line. Choose the available hitter and deliver a set that hitter can attack.

name: Approach Hitting
instructions: Use a four-step approach. Time the last two steps so the jump is behind the ball, then snap to a deep cross-court target.

name: High Outside Swing
instructions: Attack a high set from position 4. Mix a line shot and a cross-court shot, and land on balance.

name: Arm Swing Mechanics
instructions: Toss and hit a ball into the wall. Contact in front of the hitting shoulder with a high elbow and a fast wrist.

name: Block Footwork
instructions: Shuffle along the net from the middle to the pin. Stay square, keep the hands high, and stop before the antenna.

name: Solo Block Timing
instructions: Read the hitter's approach and jump so the hands reach over the net as the hitter contacts the ball.

name: Block Touch
instructions: Jump at the net and press both hands over, then land and reset. Seal the net with the hands.

name: Dig and Recover
instructions: A coach hits controlled balls at the feet. Dig the ball high to the middle of the court and get back to ready.

name: Pancake and Roll
instructions: On a ball played short and away, collapse the hand flat and roll back to the feet. Use a mat.

name: Defensive Ready Position
instructions: Hold a low stance, move two steps, and freeze with the hands in front of the knees.
